newsitem.title: NIGERIA: 15 killed in ethnic violence in Nigeria.
newsitem.headline: 15 killed in ethnic violence in Nigeria.

text.p: At least 15 people were killed in a central Nigerian village when residents attacked immigrant farmers, newspapers reported on Friday.
Newspapers said around 70 people were also injured in the fighting at Gero village on Thursday between ethnic Beroms and Hausa immigrants -- the second eruption of violence in the area in four days.

The independent Guardian newspaper said the violence flared when Beroms discovered the dead body of one of their kinsmen and accused Hausa farmers, who move to the area in the dry season, of having killed him.
Corpses of those who died in the clash were taken to the morgue at the regional capital of Jos. Newspapers said it was unclear to which side the dead belonged.
Eight people were killed in an unrelated incident at Changai, in the same Plateau State, on Monday when two other communities clashed with bows and arrows over a traditional ceremony.
Ethnic and community disturbances are not uncommon in Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation with over 100 million people and 250 ethnic groups.
